ellen_cs: Quick sync for GF-314 onboarding. Customer wants Dedicated by EOW + autoscale. I'm proposing initial quota 20 GPU slots (baseline) with short-term burst to 30 for priming. any objections?
priya_se: baseline 20 ok for their expected TPS. suggest batch_size=6, kv_cache=on, max_tokens=2048. will stage a q4 quantized variant to the sandbox to cut cost.
jorge_oncall: fine. Please add autoscale profile: 'priming' for first 36h (scale_step=5 slots / 90s) -> then 'steady' (scale_step=2 / 5m). Also set synthetic monitors and a paging threshold.
liam_prod: note renewal note: GF is in a 12mo reserved trial. if p95 latency rises >25% or error_rate >2% during priming, pause trial and open remediation plan + customer comms.
ops_runbot: Allocation event: pool gf-314-resv assigned 20 slots, burst_to 30. eviction window 7d. trace_id alloc-cc12.
ellen_cs: ops, we'll run a controlled loadtest after enablement. loadtest command for ops: ```
loadtest --target https://dedicated.greenfield.redwood/api/generate --concurrency 40 --duration 20m --rate 100/s --model redwood-alpha-quant
```
priya_se: i'll run a 60m enablement Wed 9am PT for their infra team (warmup, request shaping, SDK samples).
jorge_oncall: i'll add SLOs: p50 <200ms, p95 <420ms, error_rate <1.5%. alerts -> page if breached x2 within 10m.
ellen_cs: action items: (1) priya -> enablement Wed 9am PT + push quantized variant; (2) ops -> execute loadtest Wed 10:30am PT; (3) jorge -> set autoscale profiles + SLO monitors; (4) liam -> prepare renewal-risk comms if thresholds breach. i'll update GF-314 ticket and post links. :thumbsup:
